SELECT
    formatDateTime(toTimeZone(min(timestamp), 'UTC'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%S') AS started_utc,
    lower(hex(base64Decode(trace_id))) AS trace_id_hex,
    arrayStringConcat(groupUniqArray(service_name), ', ') AS services,
    arrayStringConcat(groupUniqArrayIf(attributes['mikka.run_id'], notEmpty(coalesce(attributes['mikka.run_id'], ''))), ', ') AS run_ids,
    arrayStringConcat(groupUniqArrayIf(attributes['mikka.thread_id'], notEmpty(coalesce(attributes['mikka.thread_id'], ''))), ', ') AS thread_ids,
    arrayStringConcat(groupUniqArrayIf(attributes['mikka.task_id'], notEmpty(coalesce(attributes['mikka.task_id'], ''))), ', ') AS task_ids,
    count() AS observed_spans,
    countIf(status_code = 2) AS error_spans,
    round(dateDiff('millisecond', min(timestamp), max(end_time)), 2) AS observed_elapsed_ms
FROM posthog.trace_spans
WHERE timestamp >= now() - toIntervalHour(least(greatest({lookback_hours}, 1), 336))
  AND service_name IN ('mikka-web', 'mikka-daemon')
GROUP BY trace_id
ORDER BY min(timestamp) DESC
LIMIT 40

WITH matched_traces AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT trace_id
    FROM posthog.trace_spans
    WHERE timestamp >= now() - toIntervalHour(least(greatest({lookback_hours}, 1), 336))
      AND service_name IN ('mikka-web', 'mikka-daemon')
      AND (
          ({run_id} != '' AND coalesce(attributes['mikka.run_id'], '') = {run_id})
          OR ({thread_id} != '' AND coalesce(attributes['mikka.thread_id'], '') = {thread_id})
          OR ({task_id} != '' AND coalesce(attributes['mikka.task_id'], '') = {task_id})
          OR ({trace_id} != '' AND trace_id = base64Encode(unhex({trace_id})))
      )
    LIMIT 100
)
SELECT
    formatDateTime(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'UTC'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%S') AS started_utc,
    lower(hex(base64Decode(trace_id))) AS trace_id_hex,
    lower(hex(base64Decode(span_id))) AS span_id_hex,
    lower(hex(base64Decode(parent_span_id))) AS parent_span_id_hex,
    service_name,
    name AS stage,
    dateDiff('millisecond', min(timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY trace_id), timestamp) AS offset_ms,
    round(duration_nano / 1000000, 2) AS duration_ms,
    status_code,
    is_root_span,
    attributes['mikka.run_id'] AS run_id,
    attributes['mikka.thread_id'] AS thread_id,
    attributes['mikka.task_id'] AS task_id,
    attributes['mikka.workflow_run_id'] AS workflow_run_id,
    attributes['mikka.error.code'] AS error_code,
    attributes['error.type'] AS error_type,
    attributes['sessionId'] AS session_id
FROM posthog.trace_spans
WHERE timestamp >= now() - toIntervalHour(least(greatest({lookback_hours}, 1), 336))
  AND service_name IN ('mikka-web', 'mikka-daemon')
  AND trace_id IN (SELECT trace_id FROM matched_traces)
ORDER BY timestamp, duration_nano DESC
LIMIT 2000

WITH matched_traces AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT trace_id
    FROM posthog.trace_spans
    WHERE timestamp >= now() - toIntervalHour(least(greatest({lookback_hours}, 1), 336))
      AND service_name IN ('mikka-web', 'mikka-daemon')
      AND (
          ({run_id} != '' AND coalesce(attributes['mikka.run_id'], '') = {run_id})
          OR ({thread_id} != '' AND coalesce(attributes['mikka.thread_id'], '') = {thread_id})
          OR ({task_id} != '' AND coalesce(attributes['mikka.task_id'], '') = {task_id})
          OR ({trace_id} != '' AND trace_id = base64Encode(unhex({trace_id})))
      )
    LIMIT 100
)
SELECT
    formatDateTime(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'UTC'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%S') AS logged_utc,
    lower(hex(base64Decode(trace_id))) AS trace_id_hex,
    lower(hex(base64Decode(span_id))) AS span_id_hex,
    service_name,
    severity_text,
    if(body IN ('mikka.stage.completed', 'mikka.stage.failed'), body, '') AS event_name,
    attributes['mikka.stage'] AS stage,
    toFloatOrNull(attributes['mikka.duration_ms']) AS duration_ms,
    attributes['mikka.run_id'] AS run_id,
    attributes['mikka.thread_id'] AS thread_id,
    attributes['mikka.task_id'] AS task_id,
    attributes['mikka.workflow_run_id'] AS workflow_run_id,
    attributes['mikka.error.code'] AS error_code,
    attributes['error.type'] AS error_type
FROM logs
WHERE timestamp >= now() - toIntervalHour(least(greatest({lookback_hours}, 1), 336))
  AND service_name IN ('mikka-web', 'mikka-daemon')
  AND trace_id IN (SELECT trace_id FROM matched_traces)
ORDER BY timestamp
LIMIT 1000
